comment: Appendix F provides useful capability details for the Semantic Governance Infrastructure but does not reference the tools, programmes, or SDO engagement pathways available to countries to operationalise those capabilities. Countries reading Appendix F will understand what capabilities are required but receive no guidance on how to implement them or where to seek technical support which is a significant implementation gap given the technical complexity of building an SGI from scratch.

public.text: Appendix F provides useful capability details for the Semantic Governance Infrastructure but does not reference the tools, programmes, or SDO engagement pathways available to countries to operationalise those capabilities. Countries reading Appendix F will understand what capabilities are required but receive no guidance on how to implement them or where to seek technical support which is a significant implementation gap given the technical complexity of building an SGI from scratch.
public.suggestedRevision: We suggest to add a column to the Appendix F capability table: "Available tools and SDO resources." Suggested entries: Concept lookup and value set management → Snowstorm (SNOMED International open-source FHIR Terminology Server); Laboratory observation management → LOINC FHIR API (Regenstrief); Terminology governance and release pipeline → SNOMED International NRC programme; FHIR conformance profiling → HL7 International Implementation Guides; Clinical-to-administrative coding maps → SNOMED International-WHO ICD cross-map programme.
